summary: Tested Scenes tab Run Lines feature end-to-end. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_reader_voices.py with 5 tests covering GET /api/reader-voices, regression on turn TTS (no voice), voice=jessica caching, voice=adam separate cache with different audio bytes, and unknown voice 400. All 5 new tests pass, plus 96/96 pre-existing tests pass. Frontend: uploaded a 4-turn PDF via UI, verified: (a) three mode tabs (mode-tab-read/mine/run) render and switch active state, (b) character-picker visible in mine+run modes only, (c) reader-voice-picker with 'jessica' and 'adam' options visible ONLY in run mode, (d) after picking JANE, MARK's 2 turns become dimmed (opacity-45) and JANE's 2 turns get 'You' badges (turn-you-badge-*), (e) play-my-lines-button and run-lines-button appear appropriately, (f) run-lines-button starts practice — screenshot confirms JANE's line highlighted with 'YOUR TURN — SPEAK NOW' indicator while previous MARK line played through audio, and Escape stops playback returning button to 'Start Practicing'. localStorage scene_prefs::{id} persistence path in code reviewed OK.

issues: React dev-mode hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Caused by Emergent's dev source-map overlay injecting <span> wrappers into <option>{v.label}</option> at SceneReader.jsx:510. Not a functional bug (dropdown works), but produces console noise in dev. Optionally avoid interpolated JSX inside <option> or wrap label plainly (already plain — the injection is by dev tooling). Safe to ignore for prod.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: turn TTS cache_key correctly includes voice suffix — good separation. READER_VOICES whitelist server-side prevents arbitrary voice_id abuse. Consistent 400 for unknown voice.
SceneReader.jsx (~620 lines) is getting large; consider extracting CharacterPicker/ReaderVoicePicker/TurnBlock into their own files for maintainability.
handleRunLines uses time-based auto-advance (chars/sec estimate). Works, but consider Web Speech API silence detection later for tighter cueing.
Space keydown handler prevents default globally while running — fine, but if a coach focuses an input mid-practice they can't type spaces; document or scope to non-input targets.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded /tmp/test_scene.pdf (JANE/MARK 4-turn dialogue) via UI to exercise Run Lines. Backend DB also had prior scenes from earlier iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scenes are session-scoped in the frontend (Scene Library shows 'No scenes yet' on a fresh browser session even if DB has scenes). To test Scenes UI, upload a PDF via the file input first. Reader voices endpoint returns jessica + adam keys; per-voice cache works and different voices produce different audio bytes as verified.
